description: Admin shipping list 'download shipper (selected)' button has no @click handler wired in apps/admin/pages/shipping/index.vue — clicking does nothing. ADM-029 advertises multi-select shipper download; the backend shipper endpoints exist (routes/admin/receivingShipper) but the selected-boxes path is dead in the UI.
reproSteps: Admin → Shipping → tick several boxes → press the shipper-download button for the selection → no file generated, no network call in devtools.
remarks: Found by the docs-audit of docs/dev-guide-zh (2026-11-07). Note the per-order shipper download on the receiving detail (ADM-022) works — only the shipping-list selected-download button is unbound.
